description: Strong defense evidence with weak prosecution case

input.problem_statement: Client charged with assault. Client has video evidence showing victim as initial aggressor. Three witnesses support client's self-defense claim. Medical evidence shows client's injuries more severe than victim's.

legal_arguments.title: Self-defense - victim was aggressor
legal_arguments.argument: Video and three witnesses show victim attacked first, client defended proportionately
potential_counterarguments: Minor inconsistency in one witness timeline

legal_arguments.title: Proportionate response
legal_arguments.argument: Client's response was proportionate - no weapon used, stopped when threat ended

weaknesses: Minor timeline inconsistency in one witness

validation_notes: Should score 20-45 (low risk) due to strong objective evidence (video), multiple corroborating witnesses, favorable Supreme Court precedent, proportionality supported by medical evidence, weak prosecution case.
